title: Softland connector: graceful rate-trim + sticky-lease repair
author: Marisol Vega
description: Background: In the last two incidents we observed sticky-lease accumulation in regional connectors that prevented fair shedding and caused downstream SLO violations during sustained bursts. The Softland connector (regional egress adapter) was retaining short-lived leases for longer than intended when a rapid sequence of cancellations + retries occurred, and our existing rate-trim policy did not account for connector-level lease skew. This PR introduces a conservative connector-side taper (soft rate-trim) plus a sticky-lease reconciliation path to reduce tail SLO breaches while preserving tenant affinity during short windows. Motivation: reduce repeated regional failover and reduce noisy evictions without hard preemption. Changes: 1) connector/soft_taper.go: implement a time-decayed connector taper that reduces effective lease weight over a 10s half-life when overload is detected; taper is additive to per-tenant SLO penalties and is bounded by a configured minimum capacity. 2) connector/sticky_lease_reconcile.go: background reconciler that detects leases older than expected (config default 30s) and attempts a cooperative surrender instead of immediate eviction. 3) config: introduce soft_taper.window_ms and sticky_lease.max_age_ms with sensible defaults; these are overridable per-region. 4) metrics: emit connector.soft_taper_active, connector.sticky_reconcile_runs and a new annotation connector.taper_reason for traceability. 5) tests: unit+integration harness that simulates cancellation-retry storms and validates no regression of steady-state throughput. Design notes: taper is intentionally conservative (no immediate hard deny) and acts as a multiplier on the soft-shed score used by the global evictor; reconciler attempts up to two cooperative surrenders spaced by jitter and falls back to normal eviction if unsuccessful. This keeps the graceful-degradation surface small while preventing sticky accumulation. Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flag runtime.connectors.soft_taper=true and rolled to canary region for 48h with enhanced telemetry. Monitoring: added alerting suggestions in the release notes for sustained taper activation (>5m) and reconcile failure rate (>1% over 5m). Related: fixes SUP-1983; follows design from ENG-2741 prototype. Backwards compatibility: config-driven and off by default; no breaking API changes.
commits_summary: Commit 1: add soft taper core + config (connector/soft_taper.go, internal/config); Commit 2: sticky lease reconciler + tests (connector/sticky_lease_reconcile.go, connector/reconcile_test.go); Commit 3: metrics and tracing annotations (telemetry/connector_metrics.go); Commit 4: docs and rollout notes (docs/operational/soft_taper.md)

release_notes:
- Introduced connector soft taper to reduce sticky-lease accumulation during cancellation/retry storms.
- Added connector sticky-lease reconciler for cooperative surrender before eviction.
- New metrics: connector.soft_taper_active, connector.sticky_reconcile_runs, connector.surrender_requests.
